skip_reason: Services offline — backend and frontend unavailable during audit window

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection — Multiple RCE CVEs
escalations.failure_scenario: User-controlled data passed to Handlebars template compilation triggers arbitrary JavaScript execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars (target ≥4.7.9); identify which direct dep pulls handlebars; remove if unused

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Remote Code Execution
escalations.failure_scenario: When vitest UI server is listening (dev/CI), any network-reachable attacker can read and execute arbitrary files with no authentication
escalations.fix: npm update vitest (target ≥3.2.6); disable vitest UI server in CI; resolves DEP-012 (@vitest/mocker) as a side-effect

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-search: /api/search endpoint not registered
p2_findings.failure_scenario: DependencyPicker modal's typeahead calls GET /api/search?q= which has no route handler; all cross-entity search returns 404
p2_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts with GET /api/search?q=; register in app.ts; wire to searchService.search(q). Tests already written at Source/Backend/tests/routes/search.test.ts — just waiting on implementation.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers access workItemStore directly — service layer bypass
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Adding caching, pagination, or access control to work items requires editing three route files (workItems.ts, workflow.ts, intake.ts) instead of one service, risking inconsistency
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract Source/Backend/src/services/workItemService.ts wrapping all store.* calls. Update workItems.ts, workflow.ts, intake.ts to import from workItemService only.

p2_findings.title: spec-drift-audit.py generates false 0% coverage signal
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Future agent reads spec-drift-report.json, sees 0% coverage, concludes Source/ is unimplemented — triggers unnecessary rework or stalled pipelines
p2_findings.recommendation: Add Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md as alias source to spec-drift-audit.py, or move workflow requirements into Specifications/ using canonical FR-WF-\d{3} format.

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection — Backend
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker injects CRLF sequences in multipart field names/filenames, enabling HTTP header injection in multipart requests

p2_findings.title: Vite server.fs.deny bypass via Windows alternate paths
p2_findings.failure_scenario: On Windows, alternate path notation bypasses the server.fs.deny allowlist, allowing reads of files outside the configured deny boundary
p2_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite (resolves DEP-010 as well)

p2_findings.title: WebSocket memory exhaustion DoS
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Attacker sends tiny fragmented WebSocket messages causing unbounded memory growth and process OOM; secondary: uninitialized memory disclosure

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection — Frontend (duplicate of DEP-002)
p2_findings.failure_scenario: Same as DEP-002 — present in Frontend transitive deps as well
